# Final Social Network Implementation Plan

The Awtsmoos gives the social world one purpose through many chambers; Awtsmoos.com will reveal that unity by shrinking orchestration files while preserving every public road.

## Read before first production write

- `js/AppAssembly.js`
- `js/HubApp.js`
- `js/state/SocialHubState.js`
- `js/navigation/NavigationController.js`
- `js/navigation/HubRouteCoordinator.js`
- `js/realtime/LiveCommunicationsCoordinator.js`
- constructors for ActivityPanel, PrivacyPanel, SocialHubApi, ChatPanel, InboxPanel, CommentStudio, CreatorLaunch, TransformationPanel, MessagesPanel, NetworkPanel, PeoplePanel, ProfilePanel, SpacesPanel, HomePulse, IdentityController, PublicDiscovery, QuickActions, StatusView, ActivityTracker
- relevant tests and outside call sites of `createSocialHub` / `HubApp`

## Actual first-wave files to write

Create:
- `js/assembly/SocialCoreAssembly.js`
- `js/assembly/SocialIdentityAssembly.js`
- `js/assembly/SocialCommunicationAssembly.js`
- `js/assembly/SocialCreationAssembly.js`
- `js/assembly/SocialSurfaceAssembly.js`
- `js/lifecycle/HubInitializationCoordinator.js`
- `js/identity/SocialIdentityTransitionCoordinator.js`
- `js/ui/HubContextPresenter.js`

Rewrite completely:
- `js/AppAssembly.js`
- `js/HubApp.js`
- `js/main.js` only if full reread proves its boot/error boundary needs the same architecture cleanup.

## Required behavior preservation

- `createSocialHub(root)` returns a fully assembled `HubApp`.
- all existing panel properties remain reachable on `app`.
- initialization still wires panels, initializes discovery and identity, starts live communications, and renders initial state.
- alias changes update state/profile alias field, refresh identity-dependent surfaces, sync live communications, and manifest privacy/status.
- navigation/location changes continue through HubRouteCoordinator then live sync.

## Tests after code

- existing package tests
- API foundation test
- state/route/comment/surface contracts
- new assembly compatibility test
- new identity transition generation/partial failure tests if the coordinator introduces those semantics
- syntax check every touched JS file
- indentation and compressed-code scan
- import cycle check among first-wave modules
- full readback of every touched file

## Second wave after first-wave proof

1. Network/Profile relationship convergence.
2. Discovery/People query cancellation and ranking/pagination consistency.
3. Inbox typed/unread model.
4. Messages delivery/read/realtime convergence based on actual backend evidence.
5. Chat reconnect/offline state.
6. Comment/composer draft and mutation resilience.
7. Spaces membership/role state.
8. Social docs and browser/mobile verification.

## NEXT_ACTION

Read the first-wave constructor/state/route/realtime contracts and external call sites. Only then rewrite the assembly and lifecycle files in full.
